create_DatasetSubset: create a DatasetSubset from a dataset and a list of index integers
create_RandomSubset: create a RandomSubset of a given size from a dataset with a reproducible random seed
test_DatasetSubset_len: test the DatasetSubset __len__ method returns the number of kept indexes
test_DatasetSubset_getitem: test the DatasetSubset __getitem__ method returns items via mapped indexes
test_RandomSubset_shuffle: test the RandomSubset shuffles dataset indexes reproducibly with the given seed
